The '''Emergency Aid Cutter''' was a class of [[Starcutter/Legends|starcutter]] employed by the [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue Corps]]. The red-and-black [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were considered to be sacrosanct by nearly all [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], and were respected enough that any order to fire on them would usually cause the crew to mutiny. Emergency Aid Cutters were equipped with [[universal airlock]]s, [[Plasma Cut Boarding Device|plasma torch hull cutters]], emergency medical bays, [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], and [[fire-foam backpack]]s.<ref name="FOP" />
